title: 'They can trust me': As J.J. McCarthy explodes in fourth quarter of yo-yo Giants-Saints game, John Harbaugh now has decision to make

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'They can trust me': As J.J. McCarthy explodes in fourth quarter of yo-yo Giants-Saints game, John Harbaugh now has decision to make
sources.description: Giants head coach John Harbaugh declined to name a starter after the game. Nine questions later, his tone had shifted slightly. When would he start the process of deciding whether to change QBs? "Starts right now," he said.
